timing.note: Responds instantly; real CdS cells take ~20 ms to rise and ~30 ms or more to fall.

analog.note: Power law R = 15 kΩ · (lux/10)^−0.6, capped at 1 MΩ dark resistance, which follows the GL5528 typical curve. Unit-to-unit spread (10–20 kΩ at 10 lx) and spectral response are not modelled.

testOnRealDevice: Calibrate thresholds against the real cell and room light
